50534374.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to G9a by isothermal titration calorimetry
50534374.references_previous: Min, J.; Allali-Hassani, A.; Nady, N.; Qi, C.; Ouyang, H.; Liu, Y.; MacKenzie, F.; Vedadi, M.; Arrowsmith, C. H. L3MBTL1 recognition of mono- and dimethylated histones. Nat. Struct. Mol. Biol. 2007, 14, 1229–1230.

original_paragraph.Figure 3 caption: Figure 3. 8 showed higher binding affinity to G9a compared to 2a in an ITC experiment.
original_paragraph.Results section text: In ITC experiments that measure the binding affinity of a small molecule to the G9a protein,21 8 (Ka = 23 ± 8 nM (n = 2)) has about 5-fold higher binding affinity compared to 2a (Ka = 130 ± 18 nM (n = 2)) (Figure 3).
original_paragraph.Supporting Information note: DSF graphs of 8 (UNC0224) and 2a are included in Supporting Information.
